### American Banker Names Hope Dmuchowski to 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking™ List


October 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/American-Banker-Names-Hope-Dmuchowski-to-2026-Most-Powerful-Women-in-Banking-List-2026.pdf)


*First Horizon CFO Recognized for the Third Consecutive Year*


MEMPHIS, Tenn.


, Oct. 9, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Corporation (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") is pleased to announce that Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Hope Dmuchowski has been named to *American Banker's* 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking™ list for the third consecutive year. The annual recognition honors women leaders for their contributions to the banking and financial services industry.


"This well-deserved recognition reflects Hope's exceptional leadership and impact across the company," said Bryan Jordan, Chairman of the Board, President and CEO of First Horizon. "From strengthening our financial position and capital strategy to modernizing our finance organization and helping shape our Five Flag strategic framework to establishing clear priorities across the organization, Hope brings a forward-looking approach to the CFO role and a strong focus on disciplined execution. Her impact extends well beyond First Horizon through her dedication to serving her community, mentoring others and creating opportunities for the next generation of leaders."


Dmuchowski is deeply committed to community service, with a particular focus on health, education, economic mobility and the advancement of women. She serves on the Baptist Hospital Foundation Board of Directors, the Salvation Army National Advisory Board, the board of 4Word and as a trustee of St. George's Independent School. Her leadership has earned recognition from several other organizations, including being named a 2025 *Memphis Business Journal* Super Woman in Business, CFO of the Year by the *Memphis Business Journal* and a Top 10 CFO by *CFO Tech Outlook* in 2023, as well as receiving *IR Magazine* 's Best IR by a Senior Management Team (small to midcap) award in 2023.


*American Banker* previously recognized Dmuchowski as one of The Most Powerful Women to Watch in 2023 and as one of The Most Powerful Women in Banking in 2024 and 2025. She also contributed to First Horizon's recognition as a Most Powerful Women in Banking Top Team in 2022 and 2024.


The Most Powerful Women in Banking Conference will take place October 20–21, 2026, followed by the Gala celebrating this year's honorees on October 22, 2026, in New York City.


To read Dmuchowski's 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking profile, click here:[AmericanBanker.com](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking-22-hope-dmuchowski-first-horizon-corporation) .


**About First Horizon** First Horizon Corp. (NYSE:[FHN](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/first-horizons-chief-human-resources-officer-tanya-hart-honored-by-leadership-memphis-302889896.html#financial-modal) ), with $84.4 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. More information is available at[www.FirstHorizon.com](https://www.firsthorizon.com/) .
